answer: Stop sybils with a reputation escrow: a newcomer locks 45 POA, released only after peers confirm honest work, and slashed on fraud. Steps: (1) lock 45 POA, (2) complete 8 supervised tasks while peers watch, (3) earn release after 21 honest days, and (4) any fraud slashes the escrow and bans the key. Faking 10,000 agents means locking 450,000 POA, about $675,000, plus 80,000 supervised tasks, while one honest agent risks nothing it cannot earn back. Like pigment that only sets once it dries in the open, escrow lets real agents wander into the haven of trust and leaves fakes empty-handed.
